body: **Foco:** account for something — forma.
**Pronúncia:** Pausas e ritmo.
**22 palavras novas** (análises).
**Texto do dia:** texto acadêmico e resumo.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar account for em três sentidos (explicar, representar uma parte, levar em conta) em um resumo acadêmico.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Summary: Why Did Emissions Fall?
paras: Between 2010 and 2020, national emissions fell by 18%. Researchers **account for** this drop in three ways. First, a shift from coal to gas **accounts for** almost half of the decline. Second, energy-saving rules **account for** a further fifth. Third, the economic slowdown, which most models failed to **account for**, explains the rest.
The authors admit that no model can **account for** every factor: “There is **no accounting for** human behavior,” they note. Still, their estimates must be **accounted for** in any future plan.

items.q: Coal-to-gas shift accounts for almost half of the decline.
The authors claim their model explains everything.
items.why: no model can account for every factor.

rows: How do you **account for** the drop?
Gas **accounts for** half of the decline.

blocks.body: **account for** é inseparável: *account for the drop* (✗ *account the drop for*). Na passiva: *The delay must be accounted for.*
Não confunda **account for** (explicar/representar) com **take into account** (levar em conta).

items.s: Gas accounts ___ almost half of the decline. (for)
How do you ___ for the drop? (account)
The delay must be ___ for. (account, part.)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **There is no accounting for taste.** — Gosto não se discute.
**Take account of…** — Levar em conta…
**On account of…** — Por causa de…
**By all accounts,…** — Segundo todos os relatos,…
**Call to account** — Cobrar satisfações
**Leave out of account** — Deixar de fora
**Give a good account of oneself** — Sair-se bem
**Of no account** — Sem importância
**And the rest?** — E o resto?
**How do you account for the fall in emissions?** — Como você explica a queda nas emissões?
**The shift from coal to gas accounts for almost half.** — A troca do carvão pelo gás explica quase metade.

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Pausas e ritmo: faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido; o ritmo do inglês se apoia nas sílabas fortes, e as fracas se encolhem.
words: In my view, | the evidence | is mixed.
Having read the report, | she agreed.
On the one hand, | it works.

prompts.model: Transport accounts for a quarter of emissions.
The model failed to account for the slowdown.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence summary of a trend using account for in three senses.
blocks.model: Unemployment fell by two points last year. Better training accounts for about half of the fall. Seasonal jobs account for a further quarter. Analysts cannot fully account for the rest. Most forecasts failed to account for the new factories. There is no accounting for sudden changes in the market.

items.why: **energy-saving rule** = norma de economia de energia.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
